inShort: B feeds return-like balls to changing spots, and A moves to each one, slice-drops it and keeps moving in. 12 balls, then swap.
rules: A stands at the baseline, B cross-court at the kitchen line and feeds balls like returns, below shoulder height.
B changes depth and side: forehand, backhand, wider out. A slices both sides with the same grip.
A moves the feet close to the ball instead of reaching, wrist locked, and cuts under it.
Weight on the front foot: A slides through the shot and keeps moving toward the kitchen, no stop.
B raises a hand when a drop sits up high enough to attack.
tooEasy: B mixes depth without a pattern. Even harder: B also feeds very short balls, so A has to run far forward and still slice-drop.
tooHard: B feeds the same ball to the same spot, and A thinks only about the feet.
goodLooksLike: The drop lands low in the kitchen and almost stops after the bounce, and A is already moving forward as it crosses the net.

drill.title: Slice-Drop Footwork Drill (2 Players, Game-Like Movement)
